command: (() => {if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089242')throw Error('Own child required');const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].filter(e=>e.getAttribute('href').startsWith('/item/all/modify.donga?itemId=2089242'));if(links.length!==1)throw Error('Single observed own modify link required');const href=links[0].getAttribute('href');links[0].click();return {href};})()
